profile_text.body:
Glean is a for-profit enterprise AI platform founded in 2019 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. The company describes itself as an AI platform connected to enterprise data that enables users to find information, create content, and automate workflows. Its platform is built around secure, permission-aware retrieval and data access governance, and it positions security and explainability as core design principles rather than additions.

Glean's primary product is an enterprise knowledge search and assistant platform that the company says supports more than 100 connectors to external data sources. The platform includes agent-building capabilities that allow teams to construct AI workflows in natural language while maintaining governance controls. The company counts Booking.com, Ericsson, GCash, and Zillow among its customers. A Zillow representative is quoted on the company's site citing an 80% adoption rate of Glean across that organization.

The site's held facts show Glean has a registered MCP server under the name co.gleanit/gleanit, described as enabling search, reading, and writing of highlights, notes, screenshots, collections, projects, and tags within Gleanit. The company's law exposure data associates it with 175 cases in California, though no specific litigation details are recorded in the available facts.
